Class VaultSql

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.vault.VaultSql
public final class VaultSql extends Object
The VaultSql class holds the SQL text for the vault. The statements are plain JDBC strings. The class does not use Flyway. The class does not use JPA. Version 2 adds group_id and execution_status in the same step. The tables are workspace, canvas, cell, trace, and schema_version. // @aa-sdd G-12 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • PROBE_V2_COLUMNS

      public static final String PROBE_V2_COLUMNS
      The statement checks the version-2 columns with one select. The select asks for group_id and execution_status and returns no rows. It is not a separate information-schema probe for each column.
